backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining NFT collections, items, user profiles, and minting logic with access control and blob storage mixins. Exposes CRUD endpoints for collections, NFTs, and user profiles with role-based authorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing three high-confidence features related to admin navigation, AdminDashboard rendering, and admin status detection hooks, each mapped to specific frontend files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose, covering pages, components, hooks, and configuration files for the NFT art portfolio application.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including background, foreground, chart, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Istvan Seidel light art portfolio app, setting German language, viewport meta, page title/description, and mounting the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (gallery, artwork, upload, blog, NFT gallery/detail, admin) wrapped in a dark-mode ThemeProvider and Layout.
frontend/src/components/ActorErrorBanner: Error banner component displayed when the backend actor fails to initialize, showing a destructive alert with the error message and a retry button that triggers a full page reload.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionF: Form component for creating or editing NFT collections, using useCreateCollection and useUpdateCollection hooks with German-language toast feedback and loading state via Loader2 spinner.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionL: Displays a list of all NFT collections with edit (via dialog) and delete (via alert dialog) actions, showing loading skeletons and empty states as needed.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTForm.tsx: Form component for creating or editing an NFT, handling image upload with progress, collection selection, price input, and submission via create/update mutations.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTList.tsx: Renders a list of all NFTs with thumbnail, collection name, price badge, and per-item edit/delete actions including a confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/components/ArtworkCard.tsx: Displays a single legacy artwork as a card with an image, title, and description, including hover scale and overlay animations.
frontend/src/components/BackendStatusInd: Small badge component that shows backend connectivity status (checking, online, or unreachable) based on a health check hook.
frontend/src/components/IssuedNFTCard.ts: Card component for a minted on-chain NFT showing its image, title, description, mint date, token ID, and truncated owner principal, with an optional 'my NFT' highlight.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main app layout wrapping pages with a sticky header (logo, navigation, login button), an actor error banner, a main content slot, and a footer with backend status.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing a spinner during authentication and clearing the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/MintNFTModal.tsx: A modal dialog component for minting NFTs on ICP, handling image upload (with drag-and-drop), title/description input, upload progress, and success/error states.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Top navigation bar with desktop and mobile layouts, including nav links, conditional admin link, admin-check retry button, and a login button.
frontend/src/components/NFTBadge.tsx: A small badge component that displays a sparkle icon and 'NFT' label using the primary color scheme.
frontend/src/components/NFTCard.tsx: A card component that displays an individual NFT's image, title, collection name, price, and an optional ICP Explorer external link.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionCar: A clickable card component for an NFT collection that shows a cover image with loading/error states, title, description, and links to the Getgems marketplace.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionsSe: A section component that renders a static grid of seven predefined NFT collections (Getgems/TON) using NFTCollectionCard, with a heading and description.
frontend/src/components/NFTDetailModal.t: A detail modal for a single NFT showing its image, metadata (title, description, token ID, mint date, owner, price), copyable fields, and an ICP Explorer link.
frontend/src/components/NFTExplanation.t: An informational section with cards explaining NFT concepts, automatic minting on ICP, and the ICP architecture to educate users about the technology.
frontend/src/components/NFTInfo.tsx: Displays NFT metadata (token ID, mint date, price) with formatted values and a link to the ICP Explorer dashboard.
frontend/src/components/PrincipalDisplay: Renders a principal address (optionally shortened) with a tooltip showing the full value and a copy-to-clipboard button.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts authenticated users without a profile to enter their name and save it via the backend.
frontend/src/data/lightHealthBlogPosts.t: Static array of blog posts about light and eye health (blue light, red light, wavelengths) with hardcoded content and nanosecond timestamps.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorReady.ts: Hook that exposes whether the backend actor is fully initialized and sets an error if it fails to become ready within 20 seconds.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendHealthCheck: React Query hook that pings the backend every 60 seconds using getAllCollections() to verify connectivity.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateBlogPost.ts: Stub mutation hook for blog post creation that currently does nothing, as the NFT system has replaced it.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCollection.t: Mutation hook that calls the backend to create a new NFT collection and invalidates related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateNFT.ts: Mutation hook that uploads a new NFT to the backend and returns the created item with its token ID and mint date.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteCollection.t: Mutation hook that deletes a collection by ID via the backend actor and invalidates collection and NFT item queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteNFT.ts: Provides a mutation hook that calls the backend `deleteNFT` method and invalidates the `nft-items` query cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllArtworks.ts: Legacy hook that previously fetched artworks; now always returns an empty array since the artwork backend was replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllBlogPosts.ts: Legacy hook that previously fetched blog posts; now always returns an empty array since the blog backend was replaced by the NFT system.
Fetches all NFT collections from the backend actor using React Query, waiting for the actor to be ready before enabling the query.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllIssuedNFTs.t: Fetches all issued NFTs via `actor.listAllNFTs()` using React Query, enabled only when the actor is available.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllNFTs.ts: Fetches all NFT items via `actor.getAllNFTs()` using React Query, enabled only when the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtwork.ts: Legacy hook that previously fetched a single artwork by ID; now always returns null since the artwork backend was replaced.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtworksByCateg: Legacy hook that previously fetched artworks by category; now always returns an empty array since the artwork backend was replaced.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetBlogPost.ts: Legacy hook that previously fetched a single blog post by ID; now always returns null since the blog backend was replaced.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: Fetches the authenticated caller's user profile from the backend, enabled only when the user is authenticated and the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetMyIssuedNFTs.ts: Fetches the authenticated user's own issued NFTs via `actor.listMyNFTs()`, enabled only when authenticated and the actor is available.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFT.ts: Fetches a single NFT item by ID from the backend actor using React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFTsByCollectio: Fetches all NFT items belonging to a specific collection ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: Checks whether the authenticated caller is an admin by calling `checkIsAdmin` (with fallback to `isCallerAdmin`) on the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdminWithT: Performs an admin check with detailed phase tracking and a 30-second timeout, exposing states like initializing, checking, confirmed, denied, timeout, and error.
frontend/src/hooks/useMintNFT.ts: Provides a mutation hook to mint a new NFT via the backend actor, with auth error parsing and cache invalidation on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: Provides a mutation hook to save the caller's user profile to the backend and invalidates the `currentUserProfile` query on success.
Stub mutation hook for contact form submission; the backend is currently unavailable so it resolves immediately without action.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateCollection.t: Provides a mutation hook to update an NFT collection's name and description via the backend actor, invalidating the collections cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateNFT.ts: Provides a mutation hook to update an existing NFT's metadata and image via the backend actor, invalidating the `nft-items` cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadArtwork.ts: Stub mutation hook for artwork upload; always returns null since artwork upload has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadImage.ts: Handles image file upload to the backend actor with progress tracking, file type validation, auth error parsing, and upload state management.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts (Playfair Display, Inter), sets up Tailwind directives, and defines CSS custom properties for a warm luminous color palette in both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that checks caller admin status with timeout handling and renders tabbed management UI for NFT collections and individual NFTs, with loading/error/access-denied states.
frontend/src/pages/ArtworkDetail.tsx: Stub artwork detail page that displays a 'not found' message, as the old artwork backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/pages/Blog.tsx: Blog listing page that merges static and backend blog posts, displays them as clickable cards with dates, and shows a 'New Post' button for admins.
frontend/src/pages/BlogCreate.tsx: Blog post creation page that renders a disabled form with an info alert indicating blog creation is unavailable due to the NFT system migration.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPost.tsx: Individual blog post page that looks up a post by ID from static data or the backend and renders its title, date, featured image, and content.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact form page with name, email, subject, and message fields that shows a success state on submission, with an alert noting the form is still under construction.
frontend/src/pages/Gallery.tsx: Gallery page featuring a hero banner, an inspirational quote, NFT collections section, NFT explanation component, and a CTA link to the NFT gallery.
frontend/src/pages/NFTDetail.tsx: A detail page for a single NFT that fetches NFT and collection data by ID, displays the image, metadata, price, and on-chain info, with loading skeletons and a back-navigation button.
frontend/src/pages/NFTGallery.tsx: A gallery page showing all NFTs and issued NFTs with collection filtering, mint modal, detail modal, and wallet/login state management using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: An upload/mint page that lets authenticated users create NFTs by submitting a title, description, price, collection, and image file with upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/utils/blogHelpers.ts: Utility functions to merge static and backend blog posts into a unified sorted list, find a post by ID, and format timestamps as German-locale dates.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Exports a single async helper that copies text to the clipboard using the Clipboard API with a textarea-based fallback for older browsers.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Provides two functions to shorten or format an ICP principal string for display, truncating the middle with ellipsis.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts, OKLCH-based semantic color tokens, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations, plus typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the state of an NFT platform project (version 3), documenting a known issue where the Admin button for collection creation is missing in production but present in draft, along with three existing fix features targeting navigation, dashboard rendering, and admin-status hook reliability.
